profile.headline: Software Engineer at Alchemer
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack software engineer who enjoys building products from idea to production, owning everything from frontend experiences to backend services, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and AI powered applications.
Over the past 7+ years, I've worked across Python, PHP (Laravel), React, Vue, TypeScript, and modern cloud architectures to build and scale production software that supports real customer workflows. I enjoy solving complex technical problems, whether that's designing scalable APIs, improving legacy systems, building authentication and authorization flows with Auth0, working with data intensive systems, or tracking down difficult production issues.

Recently, I've been focused heavily on building and integrating AI into production software. I've led the development of an AI powered survey builder built on Databricks, using conversational workflows and tool calling to let users create and publish surveys through natural language. I've also built AI powered internal tools using Claude, including a natural language to Kibana log search assistant, as well as automated content generation and data processing pipelines that integrate with external APIs.

I use Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other AI development tools daily to accelerate development, prototype ideas, generate tests, and improve engineering productivity. I'm particularly interested in finding practical ways to use AI to solve real problems rather than simply adding AI for the sake of it.
I enjoy working with teams that value ownership, thoughtful engineering, and continuous learning. I'm especially interested in building products involving AI, cloud infrastructure, data intensive systems, APIs, and great user experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer working across backend services, frontend applications, and authentication systems. Build and maintain APIs and services using Python, PHP (Laravel), React and Vue, supporting both microservices and legacy systems.

Focus on reliability and maintainability, including implementing validation, logging, and error handling across services, and improving development workflows with Docker and Terraform.

Work across API, service, and data layers to ship features end to end, breaking down complex work into smaller changes and collaborating through code reviews to keep the codebase stable.

Partner with product, design, and support to debug production issues, prioritize improvements, and deliver fixes quickly.

Ensured release success by coordinating QA, managing short-term contractors, and resolving cross-team dependencies.
